hints.text: There are two different minus signs here, one inside the bars and one outside. The absolute value bars are worked out first.
Find $|-15|$, which is the distance from $-15$ to $0$. Then apply the minus sign that sits in front of the bars to that result.
$|-15| = 15$, and the minus sign in front makes the value $-15$.

explanation: Absolute value bars act like parentheses, so evaluate what is inside them first.
The distance from $-15$ to $0$ is $15$, so $|-15| = 15$.
The minus sign outside the bars means "the opposite of", and it is applied after the absolute value.
The opposite of $15$ is $-15$, so the value of $-|-15|$ is $-15$.
